hypotheses.rationale: Day 11 (Friday) shows no 'keys at elsewhere' event, consistent with Mon/Wed/Fri remote work pattern. Morning coffee at desk (08:41) and counter (12:39) confirms home-based routine. Previous commute days (Tue/Thu) had strict 08:30/16:00 key patterns. This reinforces the 3-day office / 2-day remote split.

Still possible if 'elsewhere' keys on Tue/Thu are for errands, but the strict 08:30 departure and 16:00 return on both observed commute days makes a standard office commute far more likely. No new evidence supports this over the hybrid model.
